name: Priscila Cachoeira
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A 38-year-old Brazilian brawler (13-9; 5-9 UFC) on a three-fight losing streak and 1-5 since 2023 (per MMA Sucka and our data). She comes forward swinging, has one-punch power in R1, and is very tough on the feet, but she has been submitted five times in the UFC, each time after being taken down or dropped.

how_they_fight.Striking: Forward-pressure slugger with wide hooks and overhands; she leads the exchanges and is willing to eat shots to land hers. Real early power: five of her eight KO/TKO wins came in R1, including the clinch uppercut on Josiane Nunes (LowKick's best knockouts of 2025) and Ariane Lipski at 1:05. She loses the volume battle against busier strikers: Sygula out-worked her over three rounds despite Cachoeira doing the visible damage (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Almost none offensively (one or two takedowns a fight at most; dumped Sygula off a caught kick in R3). On her back she gives up position: Chandler took her back after dropping her and armbarred her at 3:42 of R1; Maverick and Jasudavicius controlled her for about 9 and 11 minutes before finishing in R3.
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs about 6.5 significant strikes a minute, the worst number in this group. Losses: five submissions (R1 x2, R2, R3 x2), one KO (Joselyne Edwards, R1, 2025) and three decisions. Takedown defense is decent on paper (77%) but everyone who wants to wrestle her eventually gets her down.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: An R1-R2 finisher: all eight KO/TKO wins came in R1 (five) or R2 (three). Her last finish win was R1 (Nunes, 2025). When she loses she is often finished: R1 against Robertson, Edwards and Chandler; late R3 against Maverick and Jasudavicius after long stretches on her back. She doesn't stop coming forward late, but she doesn't win late rounds either.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: One gear: pressure and swing. Let Chandler back up after putting her down and was caught coming in (Cageside).

patterns: Swings hard early; five R1 knockouts
Five UFC submission losses after being taken down or dropped
Six UFC stoppage losses: three in R1, one in R2, two in R3
concerns: Defense: absorbs 6.5 significant strikes a minute
Bottom game against anyone who can take her back
keys_to_beat: Survive the first two minutes and don't trade in the pocket
Body shots and volume; she stays in front of you
Take her down or take her back off a scramble

news.text: Submitted by Chelsea Chandler (armbar, 3:42 of R1) after being dropped by a short right.
Booked against Nina Nikolija Milosevic; MMA Sucka notes she enters on a three-fight skid.
